hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f || exit 0; case "$f" in *.svelte|*.ts|*.js) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; d="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"; if [ -x "$d/node_modules/.bin/eslint" ]; then "$d/node_modules/.bin/eslint" --fix "$f"; fi; if [ -x "$d/node_modules/.bin/prettier" ]; then "$d/node_modules/.bin/prettier" --write "$f"; fi; } 2>/dev/null || true
